name: 黑匣领航机
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original boss combat body for the 2D action RPG Abyss Salvager, abandoned-mine industrial fantasy. Premium hand-painted stylized game rendering, sculptural soft top-left light, charcoal iron, worn copper, ivory mineral edges, restrained emissive cores, broad readable forms and deliberately controlled texture. Match a coherent family of salvaged mining machinery and mineral-organic creatures, but create an entirely original boss. Camera: elevated three-quarter top-down view, looking down about 40 degrees, facing lower-right. Single full body in a grounded ready-to-fight pose. Entire body, tools and limbs visible with 10 percent clear transparent margin. Square canvas. Designed to be legible when displayed 140–180 pixels high: strong unique silhouette, few broad contrasting masses, iconic organs visible, no tiny tangled decoration. Truly transparent PNG alpha cutout, virtually opaque character interiors, narrow antialiased edges only. No background, black backdrop, gradient, floor, base, pedestal, ground shadow, scene props, text, glyphs, numbers, watermark, UI, borders, extra creatures, floating attack effects, baked warning rings or diagrams. No franchise resemblance. Subject BO03 Blackbox Navigator / 黑匣领航机: an original industrial airborne mining sentinel with a large vertical CYLINDRICAL charcoal-black flight-recorder core, tightly framed by EXACTLY FOUR angular articulated folding WINGS in a clear split-X silhouette. Four broad wings partly unfolded in a poised low-hover stance, each wing connected to the central cylindrical body by a readable hinge, four separated tips; alternating upper/lower wing shapes to show depth. One heavy insulated ELECTRICAL CABLE trails from the lower core like a short curled tail and ends in a complete grounded connector, no visible floor or shadow. No insect face, no legs, no propellers, no guns. Broad chipped ivory-gray plates on dark gunmetal spars, aged copper hinges, two restrained pale icy-cyan capacitor bands around the core and a tiny warm amber inspection lens. A shielded center panel exposes the round blackbox weak point. Aircraft silhouette must feel mechanical and heavy rather than bird or angel. Compact tail and all four wings fit completely inside square transparent canvas. Selected clean material wear and readable bright edge planes, no free-floating energy bolts, no smoke.
postprocessing: None; source PNG and alpha copied unchanged.
limitations: Static body artwork only; does not constitute animation or boss gameplay acceptance.

visual_inspection: Four separately hinged wings form a clear split-X; cylindrical blackbox and one cable connector tail are complete.
Broad ivory wing planes contrast the dark core; cyan bands restrained; no floor, text or baked warning marker.
qa.alpha_method: System.Drawing read-only GetPixel stride4; visible alpha>16, near-opaque alpha>=240; actual outermost edges checked at every pixel. No image pixels edited.
qa.runtime_scale_validation: Shape design and source checked; actual engine-scale rendering is owned by boss runtime integration and is not claimed here.
qa.limitations: A single static body, not direction variants, phase poses, attack animation, or complete boss gameplay.
